evidence.excerpt: We introduce DataTrace, a benchmark for evidence-grounded root-cause localization over typed graphs of database artifacts.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our evaluation shows that seven proprietary models achieve average root-cause accuracy 48%, with a mean per-model conditional unsupported rate of 18%.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: DataTrace uses controlled fault injection to derive root causes and evidence paths within 83 runnable environments without human annotations, and scores root-cause correctness and coverage of the supporting path separately.
